operating_thesis: Make one visible deletion travel through seven different audience jobs: experience the trial, witness the founder's sacrifice, attack the rule, watch the deletion, save the diagnostic, run it privately, and inspect the observed decision without turning engagement into proof.

slots.hook: Delete the sentence you most want buyers to remember.
slots.creative_move: Lead with the user's exact claim, require one witness, and make the deletion verdict the product demonstration before any feature explanation.
slots.cta: Put one exact public sentence on trial locally.
slots.intended_learning: Can a first-time operator complete the trial, understand NO WITNESS and identify the next human owner without instruction?
slots.decision_rule: Hold every distribution slot when the experience is misunderstood as automated truth, legal approval, or proof that the claim is false forever.
slots.failure_recovery: Replace explanatory prose with one filled no-witness example; never simplify by removing population, period, source or limitation.

slots.format: founder confession with saveable operating rule
slots.hook: We deleted the sentence our launch needed most.
slots.creative_move: Publish the sacrificed sentence and the five missing witness fields before naming the product; make commercial self-restraint—not compliance—the conflict.
slots.cta: Name only the class of sentence you would put on trial, or keep the local verdict private.
slots.intended_learning: Does the confession attract substantive release-decision stories rather than generic AI-safety agreement?
slots.decision_rule: Treat likes and praise as non-learning; continue only from located claim classes, decision changes or informed objections.
slots.failure_recovery: If readers hear moral superiority, add the cost of deleting the line and ask for a counterexample instead of defending the product.

slots.hook: What is wrong with deleting a claim when it cannot produce one witness?
slots.creative_move: Disclose builder affiliation, show the exact failed docket and invite cases where deletion would hide useful uncertainty; reward disconfirmation over praise.
slots.cta: Reply with one counterexample class and the minimum sufficient witness—never private copy.
slots.intended_learning: Can expert disagreement reveal a false rejection, missing witness class or harmful over-constraint?
slots.decision_rule: A response enters product learning only after a named editor reproduces it on the frozen brief and locates the rule change.
slots.failure_recovery: If the community challenges affiliation or context, pin that disclosure and answer the strongest objection before sharing any link.

slots.hook: POV: your best homepage line just got asked for one witness.
slots.creative_move: Show the cursor, four empty witness boxes and the sentence disappearing inside the first six seconds; narration exists only to sharpen what is already visible.
slots.cta: Pause and run 'according to what?' on one line.
slots.intended_learning: Can a viewer repeat the test and the reason for deletion after one silent watch?
slots.decision_rule: Kill the cut when the first-frame conflict, deletion beat or bounded replacement cannot be restated without the caption.
slots.failure_recovery: Remove cinematic decoration before adding explanation; keep the deletion visible and the product name secondary.

slots.hook: The most honest redesign on your homepage may be one black rectangle.
slots.creative_move: Turn the redaction block into the recognizable object, reveal the four missing witnesses, and end with a saveable FACT/INFERENCE/HYPOTHESIS/BLOCKED diagnostic.
slots.cta: Save the witness card and test one line privately.
slots.intended_learning: Do saves lead to completed private trials and specific witness questions rather than aesthetic reactions?
slots.decision_rule: Retain the carousel only when viewers distinguish unsupported-today from false-forever and can use the final card unaided.
slots.failure_recovery: If the redaction reads as clickbait, expose the full before/after claim and limitation on frame two.

slots.hook: Delete this before your next launch review.
slots.creative_move: Deliver the five witness questions only to requesters, make their own draft the first object, and terminate the sequence unless they ask for a named boundary review.
slots.cta: Run the five-minute self-trial and decide whether the deleted line exposed a real workflow gap.
slots.intended_learning: Do explicit requesters complete the assignment and identify a decision-relevant gap without sales prompting?
slots.decision_rule: Suppress on missing consent, ambiguous identity, no explicit request or any attempt to turn non-response into a lead score.
slots.failure_recovery: Send nothing; preserve the missing consent or identity state as the outcome.

slots.hook: The campaign verdict is allowed to be: stop.
slots.creative_move: Separate observed inputs, missing evidence, strongest counterexample and named decision; show what changes next without converting engagement into a success narrative.
slots.cta: Reuse the decision format, not our conclusion.
slots.intended_learning: Can a transparent stop or repair decision earn more operator trust than a vanity recap?
slots.decision_rule: Only a named human may choose stop, repair or continue; null observations remain null and cannot be narrated as directional lift.
slots.failure_recovery: When observation quality is incomplete, publish no conclusion and return to the exact missing event or review artifact.

opponent_stress_tests.Hootsuite: Match governance and calendar visibility while making every slot a distinct audience decision instead of a duplicated post variant.
opponent_stress_tests.Sprout Social: Turn listening into a bounded counterexample queue without allowing sentiment or engagement correlation to mutate strategy.
opponent_stress_tests.Buffer: Keep the launch operable by one founder while preserving exact source, approval, stop and recovery fields.
opponent_stress_tests.Later: Coordinate the visual deletion sequence without allowing grid aesthetics to override the evidence-learning order.
opponent_stress_tests.Metricool: Bind metrics to preregistered decisions and null outcomes rather than retrofitting success to dashboard counts.
opponent_stress_tests.Planable: Make every review content-bound and retain the exact approved artifact hash through manual release.
opponent_stress_tests.Loomly: Generate platform-native creative jobs from one mother idea without collapsing them into generic prompts.
opponent_stress_tests.Publer: Retain operational speed and retries while preventing silent reposting after a claim, consent or evidence state changes.
opponent_stress_tests.SocialBee: Segment audience and format purpose without fragmenting the organizing idea or copying prose across platforms.
opponent_stress_tests.Postiz: Use the open scheduler as a replaceable adapter while Temporal owns durable state and OpenLineage owns evidence bindings.

open_source_modifications.use: Replaceable draft and scheduling adapter; no credential or publication authority in the challenger.
Durable review, expiry, retry, suppression and rollback semantics across the seven jobs.
Bind every job to its exact source, approval and later observation without inferring causality.

truth_boundary: This is a source-bound seven-job organic launch candidate. No slot was activated, no platform signal was observed and no product comparison was completed.
